title: Canonical normalized quotient spectral sequence functor
statement: For an abelian category C [def-sp-abelian], construct a functor from all filtered integer cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration] to cohomological spectral sequences starting at page two [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Its pages are the concrete boundary quotients [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], its differentials are uniquely specified on cycle representatives, its successor isomorphisms are uniquely normalized by the successor-cycle quotient, and its maps are uniquely specified by the filtration, graded, cycle and cokernel squares. No global finite-filtration bound is assumed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories

proof.text: Choose the uniquely specified representative differentials and uniquely normalized successor homology isomorphisms, then assemble the page-one sequence. All choices determine their data uniquely.

The successor-cycle cover proves the coherence law on arbitrary test representatives. Coherent quotient descent supplies each sequence map, and representative epimorphisms identify its components with the concrete cokernel maps.
Cancel cycle covers and quotient projections to prove uniqueness, identity and composition. Restrict the explicit page-one functor to pages at least two.
